scope.notes: 33 URLs observed in the public sitemap. Expand using CMS exports, Search Console, backlinks, server logs and old media URLs before migration. No claim that all URLs rank.

verification.note: Public verification value from old homepage. Preserve in production or document the replacement verification method and verify account access. This value alone does not prove access.

releaseDecisions.note: Reconcile CMS, Search Console if available, server logs, backlinks, image/PDF URLs and any parameterized routes with this sitemap baseline.
Decide 200/index, 200/noindex, relevant permanent redirect, or true 404/410 for review routes using actual content and search evidence; then update this contract and sitemap policy.

Three original article bodies/H1 and other content were rewritten in the prototype. Check search intent, internal links, factual claims, supplier privacy and accurate product availability. Exact old metadata is a baseline, not permission to repeat inaccurate claims.
Verify owner-controlled Search Console access and retain its verification; find/setup valid GA4 and test quote/LINE/phone events separately from actual enquiries.

Review public output and confidential files; implement actual production routes, redirects, sitemap, robots, HTTPS and validated structured data. Frontend prototype is not a production deployment package.
Backup files/database/DNS records, retain mail records and old server, test candidate infrastructure, assign cutover/rollback owners and measurable rollback triggers.
